overnight.summary: TD Cowen downgraded Chipotle to Hold with a $32 price target, while Wells Fargo Securities kept its Buy rating.
Starbucks China will require a purchase to use seating and invest over 300 million yuan in FY2027 store upgrades.
Wells Fargo lowered Starbucks price target to $120 from $125.
European Commission opened a probe into Booking.com under the Digital Services Act over fake listings and phishing risks.
Credera signed a five‑year strategic collaboration with AWS to accelerate client digital transformation.
EU regulators opened proceedings to assess whether Booking.com may have breached the Digital Services Act over fraudulent listings and phishing scams.
TD Cowen downgrades Chipotle to Hold and cuts its price target to $32.
